# pbs_task (Data Source)

Reads one worker task of a Proxmox Backup Server by its ID — such as `upid` of `pbs_gc_status` or of an element of `pbs_tasks` — with whether it still runs, how it ended and, with `log_lines`, the end of its log. It does not wait for the task. A task PBS no longer knows — its log removed with the oldest tasks of its archive, after `task_log_max_days` of `pbs_node_config`, say, or a task of another server — is an error, which a `check` block turns into a warning.

Reading a task needs to be the user or API token that started it, or that token's user, or `Sys.Audit` on `/system/tasks`, or the privileges of the job the task runs, as `pbs_tasks` describes; PBS answers anyone else "task access not allowed".

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "pbs_gc_status" "store1" {
  store = "store1"
}

# The end of the log of the last garbage collection of store1; there is
# none before its first run.
data "pbs_task" "store1_gc" {
  count = data.pbs_gc_status.store1.upid != null ? 1 : 0

  upid      = data.pbs_gc_status.store1.upid
  log_lines = 10
}

output "store1_gc_log" {
  value = one(data.pbs_task.store1_gc[*].log)
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `upid` (String) Task ID (UPID) to read, such as `upid` of `pbs_gc_status` or of an element of `pbs_tasks`: `UPID:<node>:<pid>:<pstart>:<task ID>:<start time>:<type>:<worker ID>:<auth ID>:`.

### Optional

- `log_lines` (Number) How many lines at the end of the task's log to read into `log`, 1 to 1000. Leave it out to read no log.

### Read-Only

- `auth_id` (String) User or API token that started the task, such as `root@pam`, which scheduled jobs run as, or `backup@pbs!ci`.
- `duration` (Number) How long the task ran, in seconds: `end_time` minus `start_time`; null while it runs.
- `end_time` (String) When the task ended, in RFC 3339 format (UTC); null while it runs. For a task PBS lost track of, the time of the last line of its log that has one, or `start_time`.
- `exit_status` (String) How the task ended, as PBS words it: `OK`, `WARNINGS: <count>`, `unknown`, or the first line of the error; null while it runs.
- `log` (List of String) The last `log_lines` lines of the task's log, as PBS wrote them. A line starts with the time it was written, such as `2026-11-14T10:00:00+01:00: starting garbage collection on store store1`, except the further lines of a message of several lines, which have none. A finished task's last line with a time is `TASK OK`, `TASK WARNINGS: <count>` or `TASK ERROR: <error>`, and an error of several lines goes on below it. Null without `log_lines`.
- `start_time` (String) When the task started, in RFC 3339 format (UTC).
- `status` (String) `running`, or how the task ended: `ok`, `warning`, `error`, or `unknown` when PBS lost track of it, because PBS was stopped while it ran, say. PBS before 4.1 may report a task whose error has several lines as `unknown` too.
- `worker_id` (String) What the task works on, as PBS names it by type: the datastore of a garbage collection, `<datastore>:<job>` of a verify job, `<remote>:<remote datastore>:<datastore>:<namespace>:<job>` of a sync job (`-` as the remote of a local one, and the namespace empty for the root), `<datastore>` or `<datastore>:<namespace>` of a prune job; null for a task without one, such as `aptupdate`. The tasks of one sync or verify job end in `:<job>`.
- `worker_type` (String) Type of the task, such as `garbage_collection`, `verificationjob`, `syncjob`, `prunejob`, `backup`, `reader` (a restore) or `aptupdate`.
